elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that Customer “shall have no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation” and may use M&I or any other provider.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: No exclusivity exists under the rendered clause, so there is no exclusivity extending beyond a defined category.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes no exclusivity for any duration; therefore, no exclusivity can exceed 12 months.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: The condition is inapplicable because the clause expressly imposes no exclusivity that would need to terminate upon a service-level failure.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The condition is inapplicable because the clause expressly imposes no exclusivity that would need to terminate upon a delivery-date failure.
